name: Kahara Masaki
source:
Ranked second most popular. Easy to talk to and loves sports. He loves his dog, whom you can normally find going on a walk with.

[spoiler]He had a friend who had once betrayed him and he could not trust anyone again, that's why most of the time, his smiles and laughs are fake.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Otometeki_Koi_Kakumei_Love_Revo!!#Male_Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
